        @Deprecated
public java.lang.Long getLearningRateMultiplier()
        Deprecated. use getLearningRateMultiplierValue() (learningRateMultiplierValue) instead
        Legacy whole-number view of learningRateMultiplierValue. A finite value within the Long range is truncated towards zero (e.g. 1.8 → 1, -0.5 → 0); a value outside the Long range, NaN or an infinite value is returned as null.
        Returns:
        learning rate multiplier truncated to a whole number, or null
